neighbours.label: Selection-criterion phrasing (depends on the choice of, the first letter of, the highest bidder): the words that state which member of a set is picked
fire: Each team name is made from the first two letters of every member's surname.
The painting was sold to the highest bidder after a long auction.
The final shape depends on the choice of starting point.
Initials are written using the first letter of the given name.
The scholarship goes to the student with the highest grade in the class.
Whether the answer is positive depends on the choice of sign convention.
The prize was given to the runner with the fastest time of the day.
The password uses the last digit of each year in the list.
quiet: Each team name is printed in large letters on every member's shirt.
The painting was sold to a museum after a long auction.
The final shape is drawn in pencil and later inked.
Initials are written in capital letters on the form.
The scholarship goes to a student from the small village school.
The answer was written on the board in large white numbers.
The prize was given to a runner from a nearby town.
The password is written on a note under the keyboard.

predictions: Phrases naming which item is picked by a rank or choice reach 0.4-0.8; the same sentences without a selection criterion stay under 0.06.
